verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents an official MCP server that connects AI tools directly to your meeting data. It also offers an OAuth connection with no API keys, and the MCP tools include read-only and action tools such as sharing meetings and creating soundbites. However, the evidence documents OAuth only for the ChatGPT integration, and it does not explicitly tie MCP tools to search, transcript retrieval or action-item queries. missing for 10: explicit Claude or generic MCP-client OAuth setup, documented MCP tools for meeting search, transcript fetch and action items, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an official MCP server lets Claude or any MCP client query my meetings — search, transcripts, action items — with OAuth, no glue code

citations.quote: The Fireflies MCP Server enables AI tools to connect directly to your meeting data without switching platforms or copying transcript excerpts.
You can now connect Fireflies to ChatGPT using our OAuth integration—no API keys required.
Once connected, you can query your Fireflies data directly through ChatGPT's Deep Research feature.
some are read-only while others allow you to take actions like sharing meetings or creating soundbites.
